name: Rare Parent-Child Execution
description: Parent process spawning a rarely-seen child executable on host
detector_hint: EDR process trees; look for parent->child where child hash new or unsigned

name: Autorun Persistence After Binary Write
description: New autorun entry created after executable write to program dirs
detector_hint: File write to Program Files/Startup + registry autorun entry

name: Rapid File Encryption Wave
description: Many files encrypted on endpoint within short time window
detector_hint: Count file write events with extensions changed to .encrypted or high entropy writes

name: Unsigned Binary Network Launch
description: Unsigned/new binary initiates outbound network connections
detector_hint: New executable (no signature) opens outbound sockets

name: Fast Indicator Spread (hash churn)
description: Same new file hash observed across multiple hosts quickly
detector_hint: Count unique hosts reporting same sha256 within short timeframe

name: Beaconing Periodic Host Contact
description: Periodic small data transfers to external host suggesting C2
detector_hint: Periodic DNS/HTTP callbacks with low variance period

name: Lateral Movement Scan Pattern
description: Multiple internal hosts contacted across SMB/SSH ports
detector_hint: High fan-out of SMB/SSH connections from one host

name: Large Outbound Transfer to Rare IP
description: Unusually large outbound transfer to low-reputation or rare IP
detector_hint: Transfer > threshold to IP with low prior occurrence (ASN rarity)

name: DNS NXDOMAIN Spike
description: High NXDOMAIN rate for a batch indicating possible DGA or misconfig
detector_hint: NXDOMAIN rate per batch > threshold and entropy high

name: Impossible Travel / New Device Login
description: Login from geographically distant locations within short window
detector_hint: User login geo/time anomaly; new device fingerprint

name: Token/Role Misuse
description: API token used from anomalous IP or service region
detector_hint: Cloud token usage from ASNs or regions not typical

name: Privilege Escalation Group Add
description: Account added to privileged group and performing admin actions
detector_hint: Group membership change followed by admin API calls

name: Bulk Sensitive File Read
description: Repeated reads of classified directories or many records
detector_hint: High read count on sensitive paths or DB tables

name: Suspicious File Rename/Backup Deletion
description: Rapid rename/encrypt/backup script deletion pattern near backups
detector_hint: Backup deletion + file rename patterns around same timestamp

name: Public Cloud Bucket Enumeration
description: High-volume anonymous reads or list operations on cloud storage
detector_hint: Many list/read operations without expected auth or from many IPs

name: Cross-Service Role Assumption
description: Unusual role assumptions across cloud services
detector_hint: Role assumption events across disjoint services

name: Broken Auth Exploit Pattern
description: 401->200 transition pattern from same client indicating credential replay
detector_hint: Multiple auth failures followed by success from same client IP

name: Business Logic Anomaly
description: Large atypical API calls sequence altering business state
detector_hint: Spike in item creation/modification by a single client beyond expected rate

name: Phishing Chain Detection
description: Email with malicious link followed by endpoint network call and process spawn
detector_hint: Correlate email click event -> webrequest -> process spawn

name: Over-Permissive IAM Policy
description: Policy with wildcard resource or overly broad permissions detected
detector_hint: IAM policy analysis reveals '*' on critical actions or resources
